kebab_example: aliyun alidns update-gtm-monitor --monitor-config-id 1234abc --protocol-type HTTP --monitor-extend-info code_:200,_path_:_index.htm_,_host_:_aliyun.com --isp-city-node CityCode=572 IspCode=465 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateGtmMonitor

parameters.help_en: The ID of the health check configuration
parameters.name: monitor_config_id

parameters.help_en: The interval between health checks. Unit: seconds. The value must be 60
parameters.help_zh: 检查间隔，单位：秒，取值范围：60
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The number of consecutive health checks
parameters.name: evaluation_count

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for a health check. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 2000, 3000, 5000, and 10000
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
The extended information. The parameters vary based on the protocol.

HTTP and HTTPS:

port: The health check port.

failureRate: The failure rate.

code: The return code. A response with a status code greater than the specified value is considered abnormal. Valid values: 400 and 500.

host: The host settings.

path: The URL path.

PING:

packetNum: The number of ping packets.

packetLossRate: The packet loss rate.

failureRate: The failure rate.

TCP:

port: The health check port.

failureRate: The failure rate
parameters.help_zh:
扩展信息。根据不同协议，进行传参：

HTTP、HTTPS：

port：检查端口
failureRate：失败率
code：返回码（大于此值会被判定为异常）。取值：400、500。
host：Host设置
path：URL路径

PING:

packetNum：ping包数
packetLossRate：ping丢包率
failureRate：失败率

TCP：

port：检查端口
failureRate：失败率
parameters.name: monitor_extend_info

fields.help_en:
For more information about the valid values, see the response of the DescribeGtmMonitorAvailableConfig operation.

If GroupType is set to Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) or Overseas, IspCityNode.N.IspCode is optional. The default value is 465.

If GroupType is not set to BGP or Overseas, IspCityNode.N.IspCode is required. You must specify a value that matches the value of IspCityNode.N.CityCode
fields.help_zh:
具体取值可参考：DescribeGtmMonitorAvailableConfig接口返回数据。
GroupType为BGP或Overseas时，IspCityNode.N.IspCode为非必传值，默认为465。
GroupType为非BGP或Overseas时，IspCityNode.N.IspCode为必传值。并与IspCityNode.N.CityCode匹配使用
fields.name: isp_code
